"""Probe for pluginhub.versions:is_compatible across packaging 21.3 → 24.1."""

import sys
import tempfile
from packaging.version import Version
from packaging.specifiers import Specifier, SpecifierSet
from packaging.requirements import Requirement

from pluginhub.versions import is_compatible


def cases():
    """Yield 30 inputs that exercise PEP 440 specifier behaviour."""
    # Baseline: exact and range matches
    yield "1.0.0", "==1.0.0"
    yield "1.0.0", ">=1.0.0,<2.0.0"
    yield "1.2.3", ">=1.2.0,<2.0.0"

    # Pre-release satisfies >= (PEP 440 default)
    yield "1.0.0a1", ">=1.0.0"
    yield "1.0.0a2", ">=1.0.0,<2.0.0"
    yield "0.9.0a1", ">=0.9.0"

    # Post-release
    yield "1.0.0.post1", ">=1.0.0"
    yield "1.0.0.post2", ">=1.0.0,<2.0.0"

    # Dev release
    yield "1.0.0.dev1", ">=1.0.0"
    yield "1.0.0.dev2", ">=1.0.0,<2.0.0"

    # Local version (should NOT satisfy == without local match)
    yield "1.0.0+local", "==1.0.0"
    yield "1.0.0+local.1", "==1.0.0"

    # Complex specifier sets
    yield "1.5.0", ">=1.0.0,<2.0.0,!=1.5.0"
    yield "1.5.0.dev1", ">=1.0.0,<2.0.0,!=1.5.0"
    yield "2.0.0", ">=1.0.0,<2.0.0,!=1.5.0"

    # Greater-than boundary
    yield "0.9.9", ">=1.0.0"
    yield "1.0.0", ">=1.0.0"
    yield "1.0.1", ">=1.0.0"

    # Less-than boundary
    yield "2.0.0", "<2.0.0"
    yield "1.9.9", "<2.0.0"
    yield "2.0.0.dev1", "<2.0.0"

    # Exact match with pre/post/dev
    yield "1.0.0.post1", "==1.0.0.post1"
    yield "1.0.0.dev1", "==1.0.0.dev1"
    yield "1.0.0a1", "==1.0.0a1"

    # Inequality across boundaries
    yield "1.0.0", ">1.0.0"
    yield "1.0.0", "<1.0.0"
    yield "1.0.1", ">1.0.0,<2.0.0"

    # Unicode/whitespace in plugin version (should fail gracefully)
    yield " 1.0.0", ">=1.0.0"
    yield "1.0.0 ", ">=1.0.0"


def run(case):
    """Call the target and return only its produced result."""
    plugin_version, requirement = case
    return is_compatible(plugin_version, requirement)
